title: Owner-beta Paper source-owned SQL audit projection v1
status: companion projection for the coordinator-adopted owner-beta-paper-operations-v1 contract

canonicalization.wire_json: New operation wires use printable ASCII UTF-8, no BOM/whitespace/final LF, ASCII byte-sorted object keys, JSON string escaping, nonnegative canonical signed-i64 integers, and exact schema key sets. SQL hashes this projection with paper_0068_canonical_json; P2 validates original bytes before jsonb decoding.
canonicalization.audit_row_json: Persisted source rows use recursive JSON canonicalization with C-collation object-key ordering, JSON string escaping, UTF-8 strings, null preservation, normalized base-10 JSON numbers, and declared array order. They use paper_0068_canonical_row_json, not jsonb::text.
canonicalization.row_order: Sort by physical table label and row_key using PostgreSQL C collation. Keys are printable ASCII. Each frame is decimal UTF-8 byte length, ':', table label, decimal byte length, ':', row_key, decimal byte length, ':', canonical row bytes. Root is lowercase sha256 over concatenated frames; an empty stream is SHA256(empty).
canonicalization.normalization: SQL NULL is JSON null; UUID lowercase canonical text; date YYYY-MM-DD; timestamptz UTC with six fractional digits; economic numeric(18,4) values fixed to four decimal places as strings; nested jsonb uses audit_row_json. Raw error prose is represented by its SHA-256 digest.
canonicalization.root_hash_text: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits
canonicalization.exact_receipts: Additive request_canonical/request_sha256/result_canonical/result_sha256 columns are preserved byte-for-byte, including all-null historical rows, in event reconciliation and the three archive table projections. They hash exact ASCII canonical text, independently of legacy payload_sha256.

reconciliation_v1.purpose: Complete pre-OFF SQL observation. The operations, observations, and recovery-grants tables are excluded to prevent self-reference. Existing immutable Paper event rows are included.

One row whose value is the ledger_sha256 child root.
One row whose value is the outbox_sha256 child root.
One row whose value is the pending_sha256 child root.

Configured account and owner, beta_lineage_id IS NOT NULL

Owner rows whose source_key names an active or archived Paper outbox row for a beta target
Rows whose pending_target belongs to configured beta account
Rows whose pending_target belongs to configured beta account

All owner_beta_paper_preview jobs for configured owner

reconciliation_v1.filters: No caller application_name filter participates in a root. Table rows are restricted by configured owner/account or joined through beta target/outbox/job identities.
reconciliation_v1.sql_boundary: The root controller supplies inventory_sha256 only after protected process/backend proof. SQL independently rejects active app/worker transactions and prepared transactions, serializes on Paper control/account locks, and re-reads DB state. SQL does not claim that an arbitrary inventory digest proves host termination.
reconciliation_v1.journal_boundary: owner_beta_paper_operations, owner_beta_paper_operation_observations, and owner_beta_paper_recovery_grants are excluded. owner_beta_paper_events and owner_beta_paper_session_events remain included as existing immutable source history.
reconciliation_v1.reconciliation_summary: The returned reconciliation schema and field types are exactly those in owner-beta-paper-operations-v1.schema.json. The database root is the framed root over database_root_projection plus one child-root reference for ledger, pending, outbox, and jobs.

row_key_text.jobs: account UUID lowercase synthetic child-root row key
row_key_text.ledger: account UUID lowercase synthetic child-root row key
row_key_text.outbox: account UUID lowercase synthetic child-root row key
row_key_text.pending: account UUID lowercase synthetic child-root row key

archive_audit_v1.journal_boundary: The archive adds all operation, observation, and recovery-grant rows as separate paper_operations audit rows at the archive snapshot. Reconciliation never includes these three self-referential tables.
archive_audit_v1.other_groups: Exact database projections, catalog projections and source reference projection are declared below. source_files requires separate protected filesystem evidence; this database stream cannot produce that archive group.
archive_audit_v1.reconciliation_subset: reconciliation_v1 is a closed subset with explicit per-column mappings above; it is never a substitute for the full combined archive audit.
archive_audit_v1.archive_row_order: Within each contract group, rows sort by physical table name and normalized row key using PostgreSQL C collation. Canonical object keys sort by C collation; arrays retain source order. The row frame is length-prefixed UTF-8 table label, row key, and canonical row bytes.
archive_audit_v1.archive_scope: Full-table Paper source rows in the locked database snapshot; the account-scoped reconciliation filters are not reused for archive audit. P5 must apply the exact columns and identity keys below.

archive_key_text.scalar_components: Lowercase canonical UUID text, YYYY-MM-DD dates, base-10 integer text, and exact stored ASCII text values.
archive_key_text.composite_components: Join declared identity-key components with ASCII colon in listed order. The session-event event_seq component is formatted as exactly 20 decimal digits padded on the left with zeroes. The selected composite key components have fixed UUID/date/integer/enum boundaries.

normalization.timestamps: UTC RFC3339 with six fractional digits and Z; SQL NULL is JSON null.
normalization.dates: YYYY-MM-DD; UUIDs are lowercase canonical text.
normalization.economic_numeric_18_4: Fixed four decimal places as JSON strings, preserving NULL for nullable avg_price.
normalization.jsonb: Recursively canonical JSON with C-sorted object keys, source array order, standard JSON string escaping and normalized base-10 numbers.
normalization.error_prose: Raw error_detail, last_error, error_message values are projected as SHA-256 digests in audit rows; all other selected values retain their declared types.
normalization.bytea: Lowercase hexadecimal exact bytes, without prefix. R4 result canonical bytea preserved, not decoded through floating point.
normalization.error_json: paper_rebalance_previews.error_json is SQL NULL or {sha256: SHA256(canonical original JSONB)}. The entire diagnostic document is hashed because migration 0038:219 permits free-form message and extra keys. No raw diagnostic prose crosses the stream. Reconciliation remains unchanged.

archive_audit_v1.history_scope: Full tables, including all owners and job types. Shared jobs/job_attempts are hashed once in paper_jobs; user/config/entitlement history is in simulation; Daily publication history is in daily. paper_rebalance_previews intentionally appears in both adopted Paper groups.

internal_stream.encoding: UTF-8 JSON array per LF-terminated line; SQLx text column or psql -qAt without COPY escaping. No logs/notices/command tags. Decode strictly; no path/query input.
internal_stream.completion: Every declared table (including empty) and every one of nine DB groups must finish in C/UTF8 lexical order before references and final end. No full archive audit can be returned.

archive_audit_v1.source_reference_contract: Reference records repeat exact normalized DB rows for the listed source_reference_tables with identical keys and framing, not filesystem hashes. Consumer must validate equal per-table DB/reference roots, traverse every nested source/hash pin under the fixed Daily/R4/Paper contracts, join source_originals.slot_id -> source_admissions -> daily_admissions and source_runs -> reservation/run/job/attempt. P5B must merge protected file manifests in the same held snapshot/DrainedHandle and validate all dependencies, config/floor/approval/contract/cost/release pins. Unresolved reference or absent source files is failure; an empty DB reference set is not proof of empty filesystem inventory.

pg_attribute.key_sql: c.relname||':'||lpad(((SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute z WHERE z.attrelid=a.attrelid AND z.attnum>0 AND NOT z.attisdropped AND z.attnum<=a.attnum))::text,6,'0')
pg_attribute.source_sql: pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname='public' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

projection_sql.ordinal: (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute z WHERE z.attrelid=a.attrelid AND z.attnum>0 AND NOT z.attisdropped AND z.attnum<=a.attnum)
projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(a.attacl) v)
projection_sql.collation: CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END

pg_auth_members.source_sql: pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=m.roleid JOIN pg_roles u ON u.oid=m.member JOIN pg_roles g ON g.oid=m.grantor

pg_class.source_sql: pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.name: c.relname
projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(c.relacl) v)

pg_constraint.source_sql: pg_constraint x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=x.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(d.datacl) v)

pg_default_acl.source_sql: pg_default_acl a LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=a.defaclnamespace WHERE a.defaclnamespace=0 OR n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(a.defaclacl) v)

pg_index.source_sql: pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.name: n.nspname
projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(n.nspacl) v)

pg_policy.source_sql: pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.name: p.polname
projection_sql.roles: (SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(p.polroles) r)

pg_proc.source_sql: pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prokind IN ('f','p')

projection_sql.acl: (SELECT jsonb_agg(v::text ORDER BY v::text COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(p.proacl) v)

projection_sql.rolvaliduntil: CASE WHEN r.rolvaliduntil IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN isfinite(r.rolvaliduntil) THEN to_char(r.rolvaliduntil AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') ELSE r.rolvaliduntil::text END

pg_trigger.key_sql: c.relname||':'||CASE WHEN t.tgisinternal THEN t.tgfoid::regproc::text||':'||coalesce((SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE oid=t.tgconstraint),'')||':'||t.tgtype::text ELSE t.tgname END
pg_trigger.source_sql: pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

projection_sql.name: CASE WHEN t.tgisinternal THEN NULL ELSE t.tgname END
projection_sql.definition: CASE WHEN t.tgisinternal THEN NULL ELSE pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) END

archive_audit_v1.catalog_boundary: public schema tables/columns/constraints/policies/triggers/functions/indexes/ACLs; all pg_roles flags and role membership; all migration versions/checksums. No pg_authid/password/authentication secrets. Internal trigger OID names omitted in favor of logical constraint/function/type identity. Public extension functions are included. Exact comparison with a trusted independently installed source baseline remains required; catalog hashes do not prove grants by themselves.
projection_discrepancies: Original archive account_strategy_bindings omitted auto_apply_recommendations (introduced in migration 0026:33); added to full archive only. Original reconciliation_v1 is deliberately unchanged.

Daily and R4 previous audits serialize jsonb::text and aggregate child digests under their legacy formats. Their table histories and read-only consistency predicates are preserved here with the adopted Paper framing; legacy digest equality is not expected.
The original R4 audit included all users and entitlements; final source columns have no credential/password fields. PostgreSQL role projection uses pg_roles and never pg_authid.

An unset custom actor GUC is restored to empty using the existing repository convention; PostgreSQL does not support making a created custom GUC absent within a successful transaction. Nonempty actor text is preserved exactly.
source_reference_joins: owner_beta_paper_source_originals(provider,market,batch_id,file_name,wire_sha256,slot_id) -> source_admissions.slot_id -> source_slots.slot_id; admission_sha256 -> daily_admissions.admission_sha256; source_runs(slot_id,run_id,job_id,attempt_id) -> recommendation_runs/jobs/job_attempts and Daily reservation/publication identities.

daily_admissions(parent_admission_sha256,evidence_json,manifest_sha256,content_sha256) -> retained parent chain and existing Daily manifest bars/normalization, source frontier, Raw batch/file and copy-chain references. daily_calendar_sources identifies exact provider/market/batch/file/wire/manifest-line and copy_chain. poll receipts/state and admission/source events retain frontier/evidence identities including revoked/conflicting history.

simulation_runs and all recommendation_runs retain candidate/artifact/stage5/action/approval/contract/bars/factor/target/strategy/daily pins and exact run/config/job identities. pending_targets and previews retain dataset version/manifest/source_kind/recommendation/lineage identities; these may not be inferred only from current control.

paper_control contract_json/daily_cohort/process_binding and their hashes, accounts cost profile identity, bindings config identity, events exact request/result/payload, operations intent/manifest/exact receipts, observations summary, grants decision/consent/process config, lineage calendar/source/target pins and session receipt/admission/input/ledger pins remain available byte-exact after declared normalization. Floor/config/reader/install/approval/manifest files outside DB require the protected filesystem inventory even when these rows are absent.
